systems.system: Plan stratégique pour le Gabon émergent (PSGE)
systems.tiers: national strategic plan on which the government's public-service modernisation strategy builds
adopted May 2017; emphasises competitiveness of the ICT and digital industry as an engine of growth

note: Diagnostic names an e-government strategy and master plan and two national development plans; it speaks of Gabon's digital strategy as a catalyst but names and describes none of national class, and recommends a clear roadmap and coordination mechanism.
